contract.goal: Add and export clamp(value, min, max) to src/math.mjs: it returns value limited to the range [min, max]. If min is greater than max it must throw a RangeError. Do not change the existing sum function.
acceptance: clamp(5,0,3) is 3 and clamp(-1,0,3) is 0 and clamp(2,0,3) is 2
clamp throws RangeError when min > max
